entry.name: textedit
entry.description: Provides a user interface within a patcher which can collect typed-in text from the computer-keyboard.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: autoscroll
attributes.description: Toggles autoscrolling in the text display area. The messagelets you scroll past the amount of text displayed in thewindow when the number of lines is set to 1 and the word wrapping is disabled (see themessage) using either the cursor or by clicking and dragging in thewindow. The default is 0 (autoscroll disabled).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: bangmode
attributes.description: Whenis set to "Bang Outputs Typed Text" (0 = default) then theobject will output the text currently being typed when banged. When set to "Bang Outputs Entered Text" (1) then theobject will output the text previously entered (will wait until text being typed is completed before sending the new value).

attributes.name: bgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color of theobject in RGBA format.

attributes.name: border
attributes.description: Sets the size, in pixels, of the border of theobject. The default is 1.

attributes.name: bordercolor
attributes.description: Sets the border color of theobject in RGBA format. Theattribute is mapped to thestyle color.

attributes.name: clickmode
attributes.description: Sets the way that theobject responds to mouse clicks in the text display area. The messagewill send an individual character clicked on out the right outlet of theobject. Setting the object with the messagewill send the word the user clicks on. The default is(select characters).

The messageallows for text input, and displays carriage returns normally. Setting the object with the messagecauses the carriage return to output the entire contents of the current buffer. The default is.

attributes.name: lines
attributes.description: Sets the number of lines in theobject display.

attributes.name: nosymquotes
attributes.digest: Suppress Quotes Around A Single Symbol
attributes.description: Sets whether theobject displays quotation marks around a single symbol. Note that once the symbol is sent out of textedit, it will be expressed using quotes in Max.has no effect on contents which contain multiple elements (will display the same withenabled and disabled).

attributes.name: outputmode
attributes.description: Sets whether theobject outputs its contents as a message (0) or as a single symbol (1). The messagecauses the output of the object to be sent out as messages. Setting the object with the messagewill output the buffer contents as a single symbol. The default is(output as messages).

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Toggles the read only mode of theobject. The messagedisables any user entry into the text box. Messages which operate on the current contents of thebuffer such as,, orare not affected by themessage. The default is(readonly mode off).

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: rounded
attributes.description: Sets the rounding radius, in pixels, for the corners of theobject.

attributes.name: separator
attributes.description: Designates a symbol as a line separator. and treats it as a carriage return when the contents of the buffer are output. If the buffer contains the text "red green blue" and the object receives the message, the nextreceived bywill output(carriage return).

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: Sets theto be applied to the object. Styles can be set using the.

attributes.name: tabmode
attributes.description: Toggles the ability to cause the tab key to output the entire contents of the current buffer. The default is 1 (on).

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.description: Sets the text color in RGBA format. Theattribute is mapped to thestyle color.

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: valuemode
attributes.description: When set to 0 (default),will save/restore exactly what is typed into the object, and will output the text as a list of numbers and symbols, even if those symbols are a semicolon (;) or a comma (,). When set to 1,will evaluate the text, as if clicking abox, will save that evaluated text as thevalue, respecting special characters like semicolons and commas. This mode is helpful if you wish to use textedit like a message box, where you can send messages with semicolons, separate messages with commas, etc.

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: wordwrap
attributes.description: Sets the way that theobject displays messages which are longer than thedisplay area. The messagewill disable text wrapping on word boundaries in the display area.is enabled (set to 1) by default.

messages.name: (drag)
messages.description: When a file is dragged onto theobject, the full file name will be added, replacing any text that was previously typed. Holding down the option/command (Mac), or option/alt (Windows), keys when releasing the mouse will append the file name to the existing text rather than replace it. If the file is in Max's search path, only the file name will be added. If the file is not in Max's search path, the entire file path will be added.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Clicking with the mouse on theobject (when the patcher window is locked) will cause theobject to send either the letter or word selected out its right outlet depending on the setting of the click mode (see themessage).

messages.name: (typing)
messages.digest: Enter and display value with no output
messages.description: When theobject is highlighted, typing enters text into the text display area and modifies its buffer, unless the object is set to read-only mode (see themessage). The ASCII value of the character typed is sent out the middle outlet.

messages.name: append
messages.description: The word, followed by a message, will append the message to theobject's buffer without causing any output.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Outputs the typed or stored contents of theobject's buffer.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Erases the contents of theobject's buffer.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.digest: Display contents of a dictionary with no output
messages.description: The message, followed by a valid dictionary name, displays the contents of akey in dictionary in theobject, while causing no output. In order toormessages to, the dictionary should contain aorentry.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Enter and display value with no output
messages.description: Sets the contents of theobject's buffer while causing no output.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Enter and display value with no output
messages.description: Sets the contents of theobject's buffer while causing no output.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Enter and display value with no output
messages.description: Sets the contents of theobject's buffer while causing no output as long as the list is comprised of numbers, otherwise, an error message is displayed.

messages.name: select
messages.description: Causes all text (if any) to be highlighted and sets the object to be the target of keyboard events if the object is not in read-only mode.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Replace and display value with no output
messages.description: The word, followed by any message, sets the contents of theobject's buffer while causing no output.

outlets.digest: Sends "textchanged" when Text is Changed While Typing
